SMTO-WEB-0024 — A value in the answer doesn't match what the source said

GUID: 63660aa6-cea9-5a13-b283-406ed746522f
Slug: research-evidence-span-mismatch
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • A number or quote in the answer differs from what SMTO recorded from the page, or a calculated total doesn't add up. SMTO won't show that value as confirmed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait for the run to finish. SMTO sends the answer back to the Model and asks it to use the exact value it recorded from the page. The proof check compares every value with the page text SMTO saved and found a difference.
  2. If the answer includes a total such as price plus shipping, check that both parts come from the same listing and use the same currency. SMTO only accepts a total when both parts belong to the same item and unit.
  3. If the run stops and an unchecked answer is acceptable to you, open the Research proof validation card shown in the run and turn off Enforce this check for this run. The answer is then shown even though this value doesn't match the recorded page.

What success looks like

  • The answer shows values that match the linked pages, and any totals add up.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't ask SMTO to change its saved record of the page to match the answer.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Research proof found an evidence span whose located value or digest differs from its stored exact_value/content_digest, or a total_price derivation with cyclic, missing or inconsistent inputs (units, subjects or listing plus shipping sum).

What this means

  • A span differs from its exact retained value or digest, or a derived total has cyclic, missing or inconsistent inputs. This is an opt-in research proof check. With enforcement disabled the runtime retains the answer; observation mode can record a fault without blocking it. Rejected proof does not erase completed source access or authorize another acquisition.

Why this can happen

  • A span differs from its exact retained value or digest, or a derived total has cyclic, missing or inconsistent inputs.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare exact span bytes and derivation inputs, units and subject identity.

How to fix it

  • Raised as research_evidence_span_mismatch in _verify_fact: duplicate fact in the derivation chain, a deterministic derivation that is not total_price = listing_price + shipping_price with matching subject and unit, or located(receipt.data, locator) != span.exact_value / digest mismatch. Correct the span or derivation from the stored receipt and leave unverifiable values as unknown; never edit stored observations to fit the claim.
  • Correct the span or derivation from retained evidence; leave unverified values explicitly unknown.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use verified facts or an explicit scoped limitation.

How to verify the fix

  • Span hashes and supported calculations reproduce the stated value.

What not to do

  • Do not rewrite the stored observation to match a desired claim.

Technical notes

  • This is an opt-in research proof check. With enforcement disabled the runtime retains the answer; observation mode can record a fault without blocking it. Rejected proof does not erase completed source access or authorize another acquisition.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
